Close/snapshot shares admission mutex; each task remains retained during canceled/concurrent drain. Supervisor result is actually awaited before taking handle; failures are sticky. Recovery joins worker then finishes active once. Drain attempts all snapshot tasks before returning errors and checks retained/accounting state.

Synchronous reaper polls only completed supervisor handle by reference, keeps incomplete workers registered, records failure before removal. Start barrier opens only after actual worker/supervisor/task publication under admission lock. Poison handling closes admission with explicit sticky error.

Normal supervision still requires joined plus BodyDone or stopped. Completion-channel loss cancels actual control. active/failed are guarded once; successful worker with dropped Body preserves prior failed=0 behavior.

Two authored groups use real PublicCrawler SQLite state, actual inventory token and unchanged actual producer. Genuine CoreCompletion precedes a fixture-held actual worker return. Tests observe actual Pending/aborted requester and canceled/concurrent drains, then assert both retained Join slots observed, terminal memo, once-only counters, sticky error or success, unchanged saved data/context and actual website join.
